Logistic Regression Analysis (Revision)

Sarah Lotspeich

2026-08-21

Setup

# Load packages
library(missALI) ## for models x missing data corrections 
library(pROC) ## for ROC curves and AUC 
library(DescTools) ## for Brier score
library(patchwork) ## to combine plots

# Read in data on hospitalizations (suppressed for privacy)
#hosp_dat = read.csv("~/Documents/missALI/data/deidentified_ali_hospitalizations.csv")
hosp_dat = read.csv("~/Documents/Allostatic_load_audits/revision_analysis_dat.csv") |> 
  ## Exclude one person with no vitals/labs before hospitalization day so all components missing
  filter(!is.na(ALI))

# Define vector of binary ALI component column names
ali_comp = c("A1C", "ALB", "BMI", "CHOL", "CRP",
              "CREAT_C", "HCST", "TRIG", "BP_DIASTOLIC", "BP_SYSTOLIC")

Exclusions

  • Patients whose first primary care encounters were not at least 90 days before the end of the study period.
  • For patients who were hospitalized, only visits and labs before their hospitalization (at least 1 day but no more than 3 years) were included in the averages used for ALI components.
  • One patient (who was hospitalized) only had vitals and labs on their day of hospitalization, so they were missing all 10 components and had to be excluded.
  • Altogether, these exclusions left us with \(n=\) 707 patients’ data.

Results

Summary Measure Models

Approach 1: Proportion of Non-Missing Components That Are Unhealthy

Fit to Full Sample

# Logistic regression + complete-case proportion
mod_log_prop = cc_prop_approach(outcome = "ANY_ADMIT", 
                                covar = c("SEX", "AGE_AT_ENCOUNTER"), 
                                ali = ali_comp,
                                data = hosp_dat, 
                                family = "binomial") 

## View the fitted model summary
mod_log_prop$fit |> 
  summary()
## 
## Call:
## glm(formula = as.formula(paste(outcome, "~ ", paste(c("PROP_UNHEALTHY", 
##     covar), collapse = "+"))), family = family, data = data)
## 
## Coefficients:
##                  Estimate Std. Error z value Pr(>|z|)    
## (Intercept)      -3.05458    0.41208  -7.413 1.24e-13 ***
## PROP_UNHEALTHY    1.40547    0.50767   2.769  0.00563 ** 
## SEXMale           0.04813    0.20808   0.231  0.81709    
## AGE_AT_ENCOUNTER  0.01924    0.00804   2.393  0.01669 *  
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## (Dispersion parameter for binomial family taken to be 1)
## 
##     Null deviance: 634.40  on 706  degrees of freedom
## Residual deviance: 615.28  on 703  degrees of freedom
## AIC: 623.28
## 
## Number of Fisher Scoring iterations: 4
# Create plots and calculate metrics 
out = summ_plot_fit(
  mod = mod_log_prop, 
  col = miss_meth_cols[1], 
  method_title = "Complete-Case\nProportion", 
  model_type = "Logistic", 
  missing = "Complete-Case Proportion", 
  separate_components = "Summary Measure")

# Save plots as separate objects 
## ROC 
roc_log_prop = out$roc
## Calibration plot  
cal_log_prop = out$cal

# Save calibration table to separate csv 
out$cal_table |>
  write.csv("~/Documents/missALI/analysis/detailed_calibration_results/logistic_regression/full_sample/complete_case_proportion.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Save AUC to dataframe 
save_auc = out$df

5-Fold Cross-Validated

# Make fold assignment reproducible (same for all models + approaches)
set.seed(918)

# 5-fold cross validation of the logistic regression model with complete-case proportion ALI
kfold_log_cc_prop = kfold_validate(outcome = "ANY_ADMIT", 
                                   covar = c("SEX", "AGE_AT_ENCOUNTER"), 
                                   ali = ali_comp,
                                   data = hosp_dat, 
                                   family = "binomial", 
                                   miss_method = "cc_prop", 
                                   folds = 5)

# Create plots and calculate metrics 
out_kfold = summ_plot_fit_kfold_pooled(
  kfold_res = kfold_log_cc_prop, 
  col = miss_meth_cols[1], 
  method_title = "Complete-Case\nProportion", 
  model_type = "Logistic", 
  missing = "Complete-Case Proportion", 
  separate_components = "Summary Measure", 
  xlim = c(0, 0.5), 
  ylim = c(0, 0.5))

# Save plots as separate objects 
## ROC 
roc_log_prop_k = out_kfold$roc
## Calibration plot  
cal_log_prop_k = out_kfold$cal

# Save calibration table to separate csv 
out_kfold$cal_table |>
  write.csv("~/Documents/missALI/analysis/detailed_calibration_results/logistic_regression/cross_validated/complete_case_proportion.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Save AUC to dataframe 
save_auc = save_auc |> 
  dplyr::bind_rows(out_kfold$df)

Separate Component Models

Approach 4a: Best-Case Case Imputation (Separate)

Fit to Full Sample

# Logistic regression + best-case imputation (separate components)
mod_log_best = case_approach(outcome = "ANY_ADMIT", 
                             covar = c("SEX", "AGE_AT_ENCOUNTER"), 
                             ali = ali_comp,
                             data = hosp_dat, 
                             family = "binomial", 
                             best = TRUE, 
                             comp_sep = TRUE) 

# View the fitted model summary

  summary()

5-Fold Cross-Validated

# Make fold assignment reproducible (same for all models + approaches)
set.seed(918)

# 5-fold cross validation of the logistic regression model with best-case imputation
kfold_log_submod_sep = kfold_validate(outcome = "ANY_ADMIT", 
                                      covar = c("SEX", "AGE_AT_ENCOUNTER"), 
                                      ali = ali_comp,
                                      data = hosp_dat, 
                                      family = "binomial", 
                                      miss_method = "patsub", 
                                      comp_sep = TRUE,
                                      folds = 5)
## Warning: glm.fit: fitted probabilities numerically 0 or 1 occurred
# Count how many patients had missing data patterns that needed CCS or nesting
kfold_test_dat = lapply(
  kfold_log_submod_sep$all_fold_res,
  function(x) x$test_data) |>
  dplyr::bind_rows()
table(kfold_test_dat$complete_case_submodel) ## complete-case submodel
## 
## FALSE  TRUE 
##   638    69
table(kfold_test_dat$nested) ## nested 
## 
## FALSE  TRUE 
##   694    13
# Create plots and calculate metrics 
out_kfold = summ_plot_fit_kfold_pooled(
  kfold_res = kfold_log_submod_sep, 
  col = miss_meth_cols[8], 
  method_title = "Pattern\nSubmodels", 
  model_type = "Logistic", 
  missing = "Pattern Submodels", 
  separate_components = "Separate Components", 
  xlim = c(0, 0.5), 
  ylim = c(0, 0.5))
## Warning: glm.fit: fitted probabilities numerically 0 or 1 occurred
## Warning: glm.fit: fitted probabilities numerically 0 or 1 occurred
# Save plots as separate objects 
## ROC 
roc_log_submod_k = out_kfold$roc
## Calibration plot  
cal_log_submod_k = out_kfold$cal

# Save calibration table to separate csv 
out_kfold$cal_table |>
  write.csv("~/Documents/missALI/analysis/detailed_calibration_results/logistic_regression/cross_validated/pattern_submodels.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Save AUC to dataframe 
save_auc = save_auc |> 
  dplyr::bind_rows(out_kfold$df)
